events.body: Hospitality company Travel + Leisure (NYSE:TNL) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q1 CY2026, with sales up 2.9% year on year to $961 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.45 per share was 10.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
